primary_reference.title: SwarmWorld: Stigmergic technological evolution in societies of language-model agents

claims.claim: Across `8` world seeds with `matched_macroturn_calls_per_seed = 1920` and `role_prompts_assigned = 0`, `held_out_resilience_full_vs_isolated` gave `mean_a = 0.4088` versus `mean_b = 0.1992` (`wins_a_over_b = 8`, `exact_two_sided_signflip_p = 0.007812`).

In `portfolio_resilience_full_vs_isolated` across `n_world_seeds = 8` and `k_services = 6`, Full Clinical Culture achieved `mean_a = 0.8714` versus Isolated Best-of-24 `mean_b = 0.597` (`wins_a_over_b = 8`, `exact_two_sided_signflip_p = 0.007812`).

In `single_specialist_peak_full_vs_isolated_NEGATIVE_TEST`, Isolated Best-of-24 achieved `mean_b = 0.999` while Full Clinical Culture achieved `mean_a = 0.9955` (`wins_a_over_b = 0`, `exact_two_sided_signflip_p = 1.0`).
During the held-out shock assay across `n_unseen_nhs_shock_schedules = 8`, `agent_calls_during_held_out_shock_assay = 0`.

Full Clinical Culture achieved universal swarm superiority over Isolated Best-of-24 on single-specialist peak performance (`single_specialist_peak_full_vs_isolated_NEGATIVE_TEST`), winning all 8 world seeds (`wins_a_over_b = 8`) with higher `mean_a` than `mean_b`.

Clinical SwarmWorld v0.1 executed physical QPU hardware shots (`physical_hardware_shots > 0`), used human patient wet-lab specimens, and closed all six NHS DCB0129 clinical hazards for autonomous prescribing.
